globalCodeData_B3.focus: NCMS e-Filing Platform Launch for Digital Justice System Transition
globalCodeData_B3.dailyBrief: Attorney General Dr. Ben Odoh and Chief Judge Elvis Ngene launched the NCMS e-Filing Platform in Abakaliki to eliminate physical court registry delays and automate litigation workflows.

globalCodeData_B3.focus: 2026–2030 Northwest Peace, Security & Development Framework Launch at UNGA 81
globalCodeData_B3.dailyBrief: Governor Dikko Radda led Northwest Governors in New York to unveil the 2026–2030 regional security and development framework alongside UN Deputy Secretary-General Amina Mohammed.

globalCodeData_B3.focus: December 2026 Capital & Rural Road Delivery Guarantee & Budget Loan Clearance
globalCodeData_B3.dailyBrief: FCT Minister Nyesom Wike inspected Wuye N1 road, Tunga Madaki-Zuba road, and 5.6km Zaudna-Kabba-Kagini rural road, guaranteeing December completion while refuting illegal loan claims.

globalCodeData_B3.focus: FGN-ASUU Wage Pact Domestication, ₦400M Student Bursary & Micro Credit Chair
globalCodeData_B3.dailyBrief: Governor Lucky Aiyedatiwa approved full CONUASS wage structure for state universities, flagged off ₦400m bursaries for 13,360 students, released ₦633.9m WASSCE fees, and appointed Micro Credit Chair.

globalCodeData_B3.focus: 95% CONHESS Salary Increment Approval for State Healthcare Workers
globalCodeData_B3.dailyBrief: Health Commissioner Dr. Nafisa Maradun announced Governor Dauda Lawal's approval of a 95% CONHESS wage increase for state health workers to curb brain drain and absenteeism.

globalCodeData_B3.focus: University Governing Councils Inauguration & Student Hostel Construction
globalCodeData_B3.dailyBrief: Governor Sheriff Oborevwori inaugurated Governing Councils for 3 state universities, swore in Auditor-General Matthew Oghene, and approved two 480-bed hostels per tertiary institution.

globalCodeData_B3.focus: Police Neutrality & Intelligence-Led Electoral Security Keynote at CARSPO 2026
globalCodeData_B3.dailyBrief: Governor Hope Uzodimma addressed CARSPO 2026 in Owerri, calling for police professionalism, intelligence-led technology, and political neutrality ahead of the 2027 elections.

globalCodeData_B3.focus: UNGA 81 Delegation Participation & World Bank ACRESAL Flood Control Works
globalCodeData_B3.dailyBrief: Governor Nasir Idris joined UNGA 81 investment briefings in New York while the Environment Ministry flagged off World Bank ACRESAL erosion/flood control works in Birnin Kebbi for 50,000 residents.

globalCodeData_B3.focus: ₦3.659 Billion Pension Release for 1,339 Retirees & Free Vocational Training
globalCodeData_B3.dailyBrief: Governor Uba Sani approved ₦3.659 billion for 1,339 public service retirees (reaching ₦21.455bn total in 3 years), while KIVTSD opened tuition-free admissions across 14 trade areas.

globalCodeData_B3.focus: Marketing Oil, Gas & Blue Economy Potentials via RSIPA at UNGA 81
globalCodeData_B3.dailyBrief: Governor Siminalayi Fubara showcased Rivers State's hydrocarbon and blue economy investment opportunities to international financiers at UNGA 81 side events in New York.

globalCodeData_B3.focus: Mosquito Net Rollout, Tech Graduates Absorption & 'Ohaneze at 50' Keynote
globalCodeData_B3.dailyBrief: Announced October mosquito net distribution and civil service absorption for 88 TechRise graduates, while Governor Alex Otti delivered a keynote at the 'Ohaneze at 50' book presentation.

globalCodeData_B3.focus: Solid Mineral Promotion at UNGA 81 & Dangote Refinery IPO Roadshow
globalCodeData_B3.dailyBrief: Governor Abdullahi Sule promoted Nasarawa's solid mineral potential at UNGA 81 investment briefings and attended the Dangote Petroleum Refinery IPO International Roadshow in New York.

globalCodeData_B3.focus: NIHSA 7-Day Flood Alert Evacuation Order & King Sunny Ade 80th Tribute
globalCodeData_B3.dailyBrief: Environment Commissioner Tokunbo Wahab ordered immediate evacuation for low-lying coastal communities following a 7-day flood alert, while Gov. Sanwo-Olu celebrated King Sunny Ade's 80th birthday.

globalCodeData_B3.focus: 11th Free Medical Outreach Conclusion & Obudu Farmer Input Empowerment
globalCodeData_B3.dailyBrief: Governor's Wife Bishop Eyoanwan-Itam Bassey Otu concluded her 11th medical outreach in Yala with 167 free surgeries, while Obudu Council Leader Hon. Eneji Ashibi empowered 149 constituents.

globalCodeData_B3.focus: Civil Service Recruitment CBT Commencement & L-PRES Partnership Visit
globalCodeData_B3.dailyBrief: Civil Service Commission started CBT examinations for 521 shortlisted applicants in Benin City, while Livestock Commissioner Hon. Ohimai Ehijimetor met national L-PRES leadership in Abuja.

globalCodeData_B3.focus: Inter-Faith Condolence Meetings & ₦300M Release Toward IBBU ASUU Strike
globalCodeData_B3.dailyBrief: Governor Umaru Bago received traditional, CAN, and university delegations over 37 deceased miners, while paying ₦300m out of ₦800m ASUU arrears to resolve the IBBU Lapai strike.

globalCodeData_B3.focus: Hosting Former Archbishop Justin Welby & 6th Position in Ease of Doing Business
globalCodeData_B3.dailyBrief: Governor Caleb Mutfwang received former Archbishop of Canterbury Justin Welby on peacebuilding, while Commerce Commissioner Musa Ashoms revealed Plateau's rise to 6th in Ease of Doing Business.

globalCodeData_B3.focus: Russian Investment Partnership for Agro-Industrial Zone Gas Power Plant
globalCodeData_B3.dailyBrief: Governor Mai Mala Buni hosted Russian firm Legion Investment Moscow to inspect technical sites for gas-powered electricity generation plants in the state Agro-Industrial Zone.

globalCodeData_B3.focus: Akenfa Bridge Conflict Mediation & Oil Facility Blockade Reopening
globalCodeData_B3.dailyBrief: Deputy Governor Dr. Peter Akpe mediated between Akenfa community leaders, NDDC, and Renaissance Energy, urging residents to unblock oil facilities while promising bridge completion.

globalCodeData_B3.focus: State Government Assumption of Full Responsibility for Gov. Ibrahim Idris Burial
globalCodeData_B3.dailyBrief: Deputy Governor Joel Salifu Oyibo led the state Burial Committee to meet the family of late former Governor Alhaji Ibrahim Idris, confirming full state sponsorship for his funeral.

globalCodeData_B3.focus: House of Assembly Service Commission Executive Secretary Appointment
globalCodeData_B3.dailyBrief: Governor Muhammadu Inuwa Yahaya approved the appointment of Usman Mohammed Shanu as Secretary of the House of Assembly Service Commission to ensure administrative continuity.

globalCodeData_B3.focus: Ibadan Airport Funding Clarification & Northwest Town Hall Remarks
globalCodeData_B3.dailyBrief: Governor Seyi Makinde clarified at a town hall meeting in Katsina that the Ibadan Airport upgrade is 100% state-funded, refuting claims of a ₦50 billion federal grant.

globalCodeData_B3.focus: 2026 Pilgrimage Screening Dates Announcement & Batch Logistics
globalCodeData_B3.dailyBrief: Christian Pilgrims Welfare Board ES Chief Geoffrey Garba announced NCPC-approved screening dates (Sept 28–30) for 664 intending pilgrims in daily batches of 220.

globalCodeData_B3.focus: Appointment of 22 Special Advisers, SSAs & SAs Across Key Sectors
globalCodeData_B3.dailyBrief: Governor Peter Mbah approved the appointment of 22 senior political aides covering conflict resolution, economic development, creative industry, fiscal reform, and forest conservation.

globalCodeData_B3.focus: State Condolence & Tribute for Ede Business Leader Alhaji Raheem Adetoro Lawal
globalCodeData_B3.dailyBrief: Governor Ademola Adeleke issued a state tribute commiserating with the Lawal family and Ede community over the passing of business leader and Babalaje of Edeland, Alhaji Raheem Lawal.
